resources.string: Choose how to take your photos. I will talk you through it.
Stand the phone upright at chest height, with the volume up.
A front photo, then one slow turn to your left. I count the views out loud.
Up to 8 poses of your own. I check each one: standing, arms off your chest, hands free.
1 to 8 full-body photos you already have, in any order.
Skip taking photos and use the ones from last time.
